title: Variables and controlled experiments in biology
log: 2026-11-01T14:46:35Z match: Claude Haiku 5.5 found no bank point the same, so it is written new

match.reason: Neither bank point teaches the full idea of a controlled experiment showing cause and effect: psy-controlled-extraneous-variables covers only controlled and confounding variables, and psy-variables-hypotheses covers only the IV, DV and hypothesis, so each is narrower than the new point.

draft.title: Variables and controlled experiments
card: the one factor the investigator changes on purpose. Only one is changed at a time.
the factor that is measured, to see whether it responds to the change.
all other factors that could affect the result. They are kept the same in every group, so they cannot explain any difference.
A control group is treated the same way but without the change. Comparing it with the treated group shows whether the independent variable caused the difference.
draft.remember: Change one thing, measure the result, keep everything else the same.

a.q: Which describes the dependent variable in an experiment?
opts: The factor that is measured to see if it responds
The factor that the investigator changes on purpose
A factor that is kept the same in every group
The group that receives no treatment at all
a.why: The dependent variable is what is measured, because its value may depend on the change made. The independent variable is the factor changed on purpose, so it is the most tempting wrong option.
a.clue: Which variable depends on the change?

b.q: Leila grows bean plants at 15, 20 and 25 degrees Celsius and measures the height of each plant after two weeks. All plants get the same light, water and soil. Which is a controlled variable?
opts: The amount of water each plant receives
The height of the plants after two weeks
The number of groups of plants used
b.why: Water could affect growth, so it is kept the same for every plant. Temperature is the independent variable, because Leila changes it. Height is the dependent variable, because she measures it.
b.clue: Look for a factor Leila keeps the same in every group.

a.best: The factor that is measured to see if it responds

b.best: The amount of water each plant receives
